name: Riverstone Fellowship
tagline: Real people. Real hope. Right here in Kestrelton.

campuses.name: Tamsin Ridge Campus
campuses.parking: Park in the north lot; first-time guests turn on hazard lights and a parking volunteer will wave you to a reserved spot by the doors.
campuses.kidsCheckIn: RiverKids check-in kiosks are inside the east entrance. Print a sticker for your child and keep the matching pickup tag.
campuses.accessibility: Step-free entry at every door, reserved seating in the front row, and assisted listening devices at the Info Desk.

campuses.name: North Campus
campuses.address: Meets at Kestrelton Grange Hall, 1402 Alder Bend Way, Kestrelton, CO
campuses.parking: Free parking in the Grange Hall lot and along Alder Bend Way.
campuses.kidsCheckIn: Kids check in at the table by the stage; ages 0–10.
campuses.accessibility: Single-level building with a ramp at the main entrance.

firstVisit: Gatherings run about 70 minutes: music, a message, and plenty of coffee. Wear whatever's comfortable. Stop by the Info Desk after and we'll give you a free Riverstone mug.
beliefs: Jesus is the center of everything we do.
Everyone is invited, and everyone has a place to serve.
Faith is lived out in community and generosity.

groups.name: Moms & Little Ones
groups.about: Coffee and conversation for moms of kids under 5. Childcare provided.

groups.name: Men on Mission
groups.about: Breakfast, a short study and a serve project.

groups.name: Grief & Hope
groups.about: A support group for anyone walking through loss.

events.title: Trunk or Treat
events.summary: Candy, costumes and a chili cook-off in the north lot.

events.title: Next Steps Lunch
events.summary: New to Riverstone? Meet the team over lunch and find your next step.

events.title: Serve Kestrelton
events.summary: Rake leaves and winterize homes for neighbors in need.

events.title: Christmas at Riverstone
events.summary: A family-friendly Christmas gathering with live music.

giving.note: Give online, or in the boxes by every exit.
